claims.source: Capt. Hunter Rininger, Chief of Public Affairs, Barksdale AFB, 9 March 2026
claims.text: 'Earlier this morning, Barksdale Air Force Base received a report of an unmanned aerial system operating over the installation.'
Barksdale raised force protection to FPCON Charlie and issued a shelter-in-place order via text alert on 9 March 2026.

Multiple waves of 12-15 drones were observed over sensitive areas including the flight line during the week of 9 March 2026; drones showed non-commercial signal characteristics and resistance to jamming.
The incursions followed the launch of Operation Epic Fury, the US bombing campaign against Iran involving B-52, B-1 and B-2 aircraft.
A NORTHCOM spokesman on 25 March 2026 declined to specify affected base locations for operational security and confirmed jamming protocols were deployed.

desc: In the week of 9 March 2026, Barksdale Air Force Base in Louisiana - a B-52 bomber base - reported waves of 12 to 15 drones over sensitive areas including the flight line, raised force protection to FPCON Charlie and issued a shelter-in-place order by text alert. Capt. Hunter Rininger, the base's chief of public affairs, confirmed that 'Earlier this morning, Barksdale Air Force Base received a report of an unmanned aerial system operating over the installation' and that the FAA and local authorities were assisting. The context is what makes this the most serious entry in the 2026 record: the incursions followed the launch of Operation Epic Fury, the US bombing campaign against Iran flown by B-52, B-1 and B-2 aircraft, and the drones displayed non-commercial signal characteristics and resistance to jamming, with flight patterns suggesting operators were testing security responses. Only one Anduril counter-drone fly-away kit was deployed at the time. Gen. Gregory Guillot confirmed detections over military installations had increased from the previous year, with roughly a quarter now defeated versus almost none before. The official line of December 2024 - hobbyists and misidentified stars - does not survive contact with jam-resistant swarms probing a nuclear-capable bomber base during a shooting war.
